_comment: The add-ons this repository builds. tools/build.py produces one
.mcaddon per entry, tools/validate.py checks each one, and
tools/sync_shared.py copies shared/scripts into every behaviour pack
features tells the validator which checks apply:
items       - behaviour-pack items, the icon atlas and attachables
lightTwins  - the psu:* off-hand twins from assets/light_sources.json
